title: The Slate
note: Wren's interior. She arrives; within seconds she has re-positioned 1.5m laterally to the angle from which she can see the dais, the doors, the cohort, and the personnel simultaneously. Count resolves: 5 cohort + 24 summoners + 2 dais figures = 31 souls in sight; attendant in scene-memory but not in tally. Two tremor-handed summoners flagged WATCH. An attendant places a stone slate within her sightline; she does not pick it up. Mnehmos begins his descent.

origin.universe: Contemporary Earth — a bread-line in crisis

agent_calls.editorial_note: Agent draft included trailing meta-commentary block (CANON CONSTRAINTS: / LENGTH: / Notes on style:) — clearly an artifact of the agent reciting back its directive at chapter end. The System (orchestrator) stripped that block. The :::bubble blocks lacked who= attribution, which was added. The prose's three-movement spine, the count math, the sightlines audit, the slate-as-tool-not-gift moment, and the convergence cues with Cole and Mnehmos were preserved verbatim. Some redundant paragraphs were lightly tightened to match the register of Yuki's and Renata's chapters.
